title: This game is not supported on this device.
r_phone: This is a phone. The game needs a larger screen and a keyboard, mouse or controller.
r_tablet: This looks like a tablet. The game has not been tested on tablets yet, so it does not start on one.
r_screen_small: This screen is smaller than the game needs: 1280 by 800 at least.
r_window_small: This window is smaller than the game needs: 1280 by 800 at least. The screen itself is large enough.
r_browser_old: This browser is too old for the game.
r_browser_unknown: This browser is not one the game runs in, or the page was opened inside another app.
r_webgl2: This browser could not start WebGL 2, which the game draws with.
r_no_acceleration: Hardware-accelerated graphics are turned off or not available, so the game would be drawn too slowly.
r_texture: This device's graphics cannot hold pictures as large as the game uses.
r_storage: This browser will not store anything for the site, and the game cannot be played without saving.
advice: Play on a supported desktop or laptop with a screen area of at least 1280×800, hardware-accelerated graphics, and a current Chrome, Edge, Firefox, or Safari browser.
fix_window: Make this window larger, or switch it to full screen, and the game will start by itself.
fix_browser: Update your browser to its newest version, or open this page in Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari directly.
fix_acceleration: Turn on hardware acceleration in your browser's settings, restart the browser, and try again.
